name: fix2-refusals-not-cached
command:
set -e
source scripts/setup-ffmpeg.sh
c1_runtime="$PWD/target/c1-runtime"
export LOCALAPPDATA="$PWD/target/c1-localappdata" TMPDIR="$c1_runtime/tmp"
export XDG_STATE_HOME="$c1_runtime/state" XDG_DATA_HOME="$c1_runtime/share"
export XDG_CACHE_HOME="$c1_runtime/cache" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$c1_runtime/config"
mkdir -p "$LOCALAPPDATA/Kinewright/recovery" "$TMPDIR" "$XDG_STATE_HOME" "$XDG_DATA_HOME" "$XDG_CACHE_HOME" "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
test "$(awk '/MemAvailable/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo)" -ge 6291456
flock -o /tmp/kinewright-cargo-heavy.lock env CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4 RUST_TEST_THREADS=4 timeout --kill-after=5s 600s nice -n 10 cargo test -p kinewright-agent --lib writer_host::ja_s3_host::s3_fix2_no_lease_reads_and_refusals_cannot_replace_slot -- --exact --test-threads=1 --nocapture
red_summary: test result: FAILED. 0 passed; 1 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 723 filtered out; finished in 0.24s
green_summary: test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 723 filtered out; finished in 0.58s
